name: DreamBench++
intro: DreamBench++ 是面向个性化图像生成的人类偏好对齐基准。它收集 150 张多样参考图像并为每张图设计 9 个不同难度的提示，通过包含内部思考与任务强化的 GPT-4o 两阶段协议，分别评估概念保持和提示遵循，并用独立人工评分验证自动指标的一致性。
build_method: 多来源图像整理, 分层提示设计, GPT-4o 人类对齐评测, 人工一致性验证
metric: GPT-4o Concept Preservation (0–4), GPT-4o Prompt Following (0–4), Krippendorff's Alpha
eval_feature: 概念保持与提示遵循双维度, 内部思考, 任务强化, 人类偏好对齐
scale: 150张参考图像, 1,350个提示, 7种生成方法, 7位人工标注员
build_method_en: Multi-source image curation, stratified prompt design, human-aligned GPT-4o evaluation, human agreement validation
eval_feature_en: Concept preservation and prompt following, internal thinking, task reinforcement, human-preference alignment
intro_en: DreamBench++ is a human-aligned benchmark for personalized image generation. It curates 150 diverse reference images and nine prompts per image, evaluates concept preservation and prompt following through a two-step GPT-4o protocol with internal thinking and task reinforcement, and validates the automated scores against independent human ratings.
scale_en: 150 reference images, 1,350 prompts, 7 generation methods, 7 human annotators
metric_en: GPT-4o Concept Preservation (0–4), GPT-4o Prompt Following (0–4), Krippendorff's Alpha
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Curate 150 copyright-checked reference images from four sources"] --> B["Write nine prompts per image across photorealistic, non-photorealistic, and imaginative settings"]
    B --> C["Generate personalized outputs with seven modern methods"]
    C --> D["Compose human-written GPT-4o meta-prompts with task, rubric, 0–4 range, and format"]
    D --> E["Run internal task summary and scoring plan for self-alignment"]
    E --> F["Score concept preservation and prompt following independently"]
    F --> G["Compare GPT-4o, DINO, and CLIP metrics with ratings from seven trained human annotators"]

flowchart LR

    D --> E["先做内部任务总结与评分计划以实现自对齐"]
    E --> F["分别评估概念保持与提示遵循"]

drawio_review_note: Aligned with DreamBench++ arXiv:2406.16855 / ICLR 2025 Sections 2–4, Figure 3, and the official project and repository. The diagram records the four image sources and copyright check; 150 references split into 120 photorealistic and 30 non-photorealistic images across live subject, object, and style; nine prompts per image split 4/3/2; seven evaluated generation methods; human-written GPT-4o meta-prompts with task, rubric, 0–4 range, and format; internal task summary and planning for self-alignment; task-reinforced concept-preservation and prompt-following scores; and independent ratings from seven trained annotators with at least two ratings per instance for Krippendorff analysis.
